# .github (Bonjoski Organization)

> Organization-wide community health files, standard security disclosure policies (SECURITY.md), and default workflows for the Bonjoski ecosystem.

## Core Capabilities
- Centralized Governance: Defines default community health files, issue templates, and pull request guidelines.
- Standard Security Policy: Maintains organizational `SECURITY.md` for responsible vulnerability disclosure.
- Ecosystem Profile: Houses public landing page for github.com/bonjoski.

## Documentation
- Parent Runbook: `docs/knowledge-base/12-spanreed-and-governance.md` in repository `spanreed`
